name: 西・魔法の森 (Enchanted Forest & Magical Clock Tower)
theme: Cute, lively and a little mysterious night forest: glowing mushrooms, a face tree that winks, bats, a shallow glowing pond and the M07 clock tower.

Anchor.role: M07 magical clock tower at the end of the west main road; front (dial, stairs) faces east.

Circulation.loop_description: Main road -> pond spur and arched bridge -> north boardwalk -> lookout -> west boardwalk behind the tower -> rest spot -> south boardwalk -> south spur -> main road. The NW and SW side bridges land next to the north and south boardwalk ends.

Framing.left_edge: EFR_GatePillar_001 and EFR_FaceTree_001 (north of the road)

Story_Cluster.story: Lantern stumps and a grinning old tree welcome visitors off the west bridge.
A glowing shallow pond with lilies under an arched bridge.
Watch the hands move and the bell ring from the end of the road.
Benches under a giant glowing mushroom at the south-west corner.
A witch-hat lookout with a telescope over the cliff.
A small bat flock circles above the south grove.
